invoicing.title: Invoices
invoicing.subtitle: Quotes, invoices and customer credit notes. Issuing assigns the number, posts the entry and certifies the invoice when the country pack requires it.
invoicing.emptyBody: Create a quote or an invoice: net, VAT and gross totals are computed from the country pack rates.
invoicing.totals.outstandingHint: Issued invoices only, excluding quotes and credit notes.
invoicing.partner.label: Partner
invoicing.partner.name: Name
invoicing.form.subtitle: Pack {pack} · currency {currency}. The draft is saved, then issued from its page.
invoicing.form.issueHint: Issuing (number, entry, certification) happens from the document page.
invoicing.form.noRates: No VAT rate loaded for this pack: lines will be computed without VAT.
invoicing.form.errorLines: Check the lines: label, quantity and amounts must be valid.
invoicing.form.errorAccount: Each free line needs an account number (2 to 13 digits).
invoicing.actions.issueConfirm: The document gets its final number, the sales entry is posted and the invoice is certified when the pack requires it. This cannot be undone.
invoicing.actions.convertConfirm: A draft invoice is created from this quote.
invoicing.actions.creditNoteConfirm: A draft credit note with all lines is created.
invoicing.actions.cancelConfirm: The document becomes cancelled; an issued invoice is reversed.
invoicing.actions.acceptConfirm: Mark this quote as accepted by the customer.
invoicing.actions.refuseConfirm: Mark this quote as refused by the customer.
invoicing.actions.dunningConfirm: Record a reminder on this invoice.
invoicing.actions.paymentLinkConfirm: Create a payment link for the outstanding amount.
invoicing.actions.certificationHint: The pack requires certification ({system}) when issuing invoices.
invoicing.actions.certificationRequired: Certification required ({system}): no connector is configured, the invoice cannot be issued. Configure CERTIFICATION_CONNECTOR on the API or contact your administrator.
invoicing.actions.certificationFailed: Certification ({system}) failed; the document stays a draft.
invoicing.payments.pageSubtitle: Receipts and disbursements, four-eyes approval, aged balances and reminders.
invoicing.payments.title: Payments and allocations
invoicing.payments.hint: Recorded payments allocated to this document.
invoicing.payments.newSubtitle: Customer receipt or supplier / employee disbursement, allocated to open documents.
invoicing.payments.emptyBody: Record a receipt or a disbursement; above the company threshold a second user must approve.
invoicing.payments.pickPartnerFirst: Pick a partner first to see its open documents.
invoicing.payments.noOpenDocuments: No open document for this partner; the payment will stay unallocated.
invoicing.payments.errorOverAllocated: The allocated total exceeds the payment amount.
invoicing.payments.pending: Payment {number} recorded: amount above threshold, awaiting approval by another user.
invoicing.payments.approveConfirm: Approve payment {number}: the entry will be posted and allocations applied.
invoicing.payments.rejectConfirm: Reject payment {number}; it will never be posted.
invoicing.payments.sodHint: Separation of duties: the approver must be an OWNER or ACCOUNTANT other than the payment's author.
invoicing.payments.sameUser: Refused: you created this payment, another user must approve it.
invoicing.links.title: Payment links
invoicing.dunning.title: Reminders
invoicing.dunning.hint: Overdue unpaid invoices; the suggested level is highlighted.
invoicing.dunning.overdueHint: Invoice overdue by {days} days; last reminder level: {level}.
invoicing.timeline.title: Timeline
invoicing.pdf.title: PDF data
invoicing.pdf.hint: Render data: issuer, recipient, VAT summary, certification.
invoicing.expense.title: Expenses
invoicing.expense.subtitle: Supplier invoices and expense claims; posted with deductible VAT.
invoicing.expense.emptyBody: Enter a supplier invoice or capture a document for the AI to read.
invoicing.expense.issueHint: Posting happens from the document page.
invoicing.expense.postConfirm: The document gets its number and the purchase entry is posted (expense, deductible VAT, payable). Cannot be undone.
invoicing.form.packDraft: Rates from pack {pack}, awaiting validation: indicative.
